description: Generate an image with a proprietary image model offered by BitPull (see list_ai_models, modality "image"). Saves it to a file and returns the path. Requests to these models pass through the BitPull server to the AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google…): they are NOT end-to-end encrypted. Do not send secrets or personal data the user has not agreed to share. Paid in BitPull credits.
name: generate_image_ai
